RootQuery.hbForm(id: Int!, language: String): HbForm
RootQuery.hbForms: [HbFormListItem!]
RootMutation.hbSubmitForm(input: HbSubmitFormInput!): HbSubmitFormPayload

type HbConditionalLogic {
  action: HbConditionalLogicActionEnum!
  logicType: HbConditionalLogicTypeEnum!
  rules: [HbConditionalLogicRule!]!
}

enum HbConditionalLogicActionEnum {
  HIDE
  SHOW
}

type HbConditionalLogicRule {
  fieldName: String!
  operator: String!
  value: String
}

enum HbConditionalLogicTypeEnum {
  ALL
  ANY
}

type HbForm {
  createdAt: String!
  databaseId: Int!
  fields: [HbFormField!]!
  settings: HbFormSettings!
  steps: [HbFormStep!]!
  title: String
  updatedAt: String!
}

enum HbFormAfterSubmitEnum {
  MESSAGE
  REDIRECT
}

type HbFormError {
  message: String!
  name: String
}

type HbFormField {
  conditionalLogic: HbConditionalLogic
  errorMessage: String
  format: String
  isMultiple: Boolean!
  isRequired: Boolean!
  label: String
  max: String
  min: String
  name: String!
  options: [HbFormOption!]
  pattern: String
  placeholder: String
  type: String!
}

input HbFormFieldInput {
  name: String!
  value: String
}

type HbFormListItem {
  createdAt: String!
  databaseId: Int!
  entryCount: Int
  title: String
}

type HbFormOption {
  label: String!
  value: String!
}

type HbFormSettings {
  afterSubmit: HbFormAfterSubmitEnum!
  redirectUrl: String
  submitText: String
  successMessage: String
}

type HbFormStep {
  fields: [HbFormField!]!
}

input HbSubmitFormInput {
  clientMutationId: String
  fields: [HbFormFieldInput!]!
  formId: Int!
  language: String
  pageUrl: String
}

type HbSubmitFormPayload {
  clientMutationId: String
  entryId: Int
  errors: [HbFormError!]!
  message: String
  success: Boolean!
}
